footer.description: Rwanda's leading bus ticket booking platform. Book intercity and cross-border bus routes online from Kigali. Pay with MTN Mobile Money, Airtel Money & M-Pesa. Real-time tracking, instant e-tickets.
footer.copyright: Katisha Transport System. All rights reserved.

guide.title: Booking Guide
guide.subtitle: Everything you need to know about booking bus tickets on Katisha.
guide.step1Desc: Enter your origin and destination to find available buses and schedules.
guide.step2Desc: Choose your preferred departure time and seat.
guide.step3Desc: Review your booking details and choose a payment method.
guide.step4Desc: Receive your e-ticket via SMS or email — show it at boarding.
guide.payment1Desc: Pay instantly using MTN MoMo. Dial *182# or use the app.
guide.payment2Desc: Pay using Airtel Money. Dial *500# or use the Airtel Money app.
guide.payment3Desc: Available for East African routes. Pay via M-Pesa across the region.
guide.lateArrivalDesc: If you arrive late and miss the bus, the ticket amount is forfeited. No refund or rescheduling will be provided for no-shows or late arrivals. Please arrive at the departure point at least 30 minutes before the scheduled departure.
guide.allBookingsDesc: Cancellations must be made at least 1 day (24 hours) before the scheduled departure time. This applies to all bookings — both Rwanda domestic and cross-border East African routes. Cancellations made after this window will not be eligible for a refund.
guide.freeTicketsDesc: Earn 1 free ticket for every 10 paid  bookings. Free tickets can be used on any route. Simply select 'Use free ticket' during checkout and no payment will be required.
guide.freeTicketsHow: How to use your free ticket:
guide.freeTicketsStep1: Complete your booking as normal until you reach the payment step.
guide.freeTicketsStep2: Toggle 'Use free ticket' before selecting a payment method.
guide.freeTicketsStep3: Confirm your booking — no payment needed!
guide.supportDesc: Our support team is ready to help you with any questions or issues.
guide.testimonial1: Booked my Kigali to Kampala trip in under two minutes — the e-ticket arrived instantly.
guide.testimonial2: Paying with MTN MoMo was seamless, and the fare was exactly the RURA-approved price.
guide.testimonial3: The live tracking is a game changer — I knew exactly when the bus was arriving.
guide.agentsAtStationDesc: Our agents are available at major bus stations to assist you with boarding, ticket verification, and any questions you may have. Look for the Katisha uniform at the terminal.
guide.pickupStatusDesc: If you have selected a pickup point, you can call the support line above to inquire about the pickup status and estimated arrival time of your bus.
guide.destinationsTitle: Where do you want to go?
guide.destinationsDesc: Book bus tickets from Kigali to cities across Rwanda and East Africa. All journeys depart from Kigali.
